mapper.select: SELECT * FROM course_level WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY sort, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course_level (store_id, name, sort, status) VALUES (#{storeId}, #{name}, COALESCE(#{sort},0), COALESCE(#{status},1))
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM course_level WHERE id = #{id} AND store_id = #{storeId}
